title: PS Technical Consultant III-PL/SQL Dev Cum DBA
description:
**About NCR Atleos**

NCR Atleos, headquartered in Atlanta, is a leader in expanding financial access. Our dedicated 20,000 employees optimize the branch, improve operational efficiency and maximize self-service availability for financial institutions and retailers across the globe.

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a highly skilled **Database (Oracle and/or Postgress) DBA & PL/SQL Developer** to join our Professional Services team supporting mission-critical EFT Switch and Payment Processing platforms.

This is a hybrid role with equal responsibility for:

* Database Administration (40%)
* PL/SQL(pgSQL) Development (60%)

The ideal candidate will have strong experience managing databases while also developing high-performance PL/SQL solutions.

Prior exposure to EFT Switching applications such as Authentic, Base24, Postilion, IST Switch, or similar payment platforms is highly desirable.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Database Administration (80%)**

* Install, configure, upgrade, and maintain Oracle 11g/12c/19c databases.
* Manage RAC, Data Guard, RMAN Backup & Recovery environments.
* Monitor database performance using OEM, AWR, ASH, and ADDM reports.
* Perform database patching, upgrades, and security hardening.
* Manage users, roles, schemas, privileges, and tablespaces.
* Implement backup, recovery, and disaster recovery procedures.
* Conduct performance tuning and capacity planning.
* Troubleshoot production database issues and support critical incidents.

**PL/SQL(pgSQL) Development (20%)**

* Design and develop packages, procedures, functions, triggers, and views.
* Write and optimize complex SQL queries for high-volume transaction systems.
* Support payment transaction processing workflows.
* Develop database interfaces and backend business logic.
* Perform SQL performance tuning.
* Create data migration and ETL scripts.
* Conduct code reviews and maintain technical documentation.
* Support QA, UAT, and production releases.

**EFT Switch & Payment Processing**

* Support database components of EFT Switch and payment applications.
* Analyze transaction failures and reconciliation issues.
* Maintain transaction routing and configuration tables.
* Support settlement and authorization processing.
* Work closely with application support teams and clients.
* Participate in supporting client implementations and production deployments.

**Required Qualifications**

**Core Database Skills**

* 4+ years of DBA experience.
* Strong experience with Oracle and/or Postgress
* HA & Replication tools
* RMAN Backup & Recovery.
* Database Monitoring.
* Database Performance Tuning.

**Development Skills**

* Advanced PL/SQL (pgSQL) development.
* Stored Procedures.
* Packages.
* Triggers.
* Functions.
* Complex SQL Query Development.
* Query Optimization.

**Payment Domain**

* Experience supporting & implementing EFT Switch or payment processing systems.

**Nice to Have**

* Authentic Switch.
* Base24.
* Postilion.
* IST Switch.
* ISO 8583.
* UPI/NPCI.
* PostgreSQL exposure.
* Liquibase/Flyway.
* Shell scripting (Bash).

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

We are looking for candidates currently working as:

* DBA & PL/SQL Developer
* Senior DB Developer with DBA responsibilities
* DB Production Support Engineer

title: Principal Oracle DBA
description:
**About the role**

As a Principal Oracle Database Administrator, you are a results‑driven, customer‑focused technical leader responsible for the reliability, performance, and security of Blackbaud’s enterprise Oracle database platforms. You bring a strong sense of ownership and accountability, delivering outcomes that support both operational excellence and customer commitments while helping power the work of purpose‑driven organisations.

* Deliver reliable and secure Oracle database services by owning day‑to‑day operations, availability, and performance across production environments.
* Improve scalability and resilience by installing, upgrading, patching, and managing Oracle databases using automation‑first approaches.
* Protect critical data by executing and validating backup, recovery, replication, and high‑availability strategies.

title: OpenShift Virtualization & Linux Platform Team Lead
description:
**Function**

IT

**Our Company**
===============

We’re Hitachi Vantara, the data foundation trusted by the world’s innovators. Our resilient, high-performance data infrastructure means that customers – from banks to theme parks – can focus on achieving the incredible with data.

If you’ve seen the Las Vegas Sphere, you’ve seen just one example of how we empower businesses to automate, optimize, innovate – and wow their customers. Right now, we’re laying the foundation for our next wave of growth. We’re looking for people who love being part of a diverse, global team – and who get excited about making a real-world impact with data.

**Job description**
===================

The Role

  

Lead the architecture, deployment, and operation of enterprise OpenShift Virtualization and Linux platforms. This hands-on role owns platform reliability, security, automation, patching, monitoring, recovery, and lifecycle management across OpenShift, RHEL, Red Hat Satellite, Ansible, NFS, and virtual machines. The position also leads complex troubleshooting, supports critical workloads, mentors engineers, and coordinates with infrastructure, cloud, security, application, database, and vendor teams.

  

Design, deploy, administer, and support OpenShift Container Platform and OpenShift Virtualization in production.

* Define standards for cluster architecture, virtualization worker nodes, VM placement, capacity, security, availability, and lifecycle management.

* Manage VM provisioning, templates, images, DataVolumes, persistent storage, snapshots, cloning, live migration, backup, recovery, and maintenance.

* Plan platform upgrades; perform health, compatibility, capacity, and post-change validation; maintain architecture and operating documentation.

* Provide expert-level RHEL administration and troubleshooting across system services, boot, kernel, networking, storage, filesystems, LVM, logging, SELinux, certificates, and performance.

* Own Red Hat Satellite for content, subscriptions, host lifecycle, provisioning, patching, compliance, and reporting.

* Plan and execute OS patching, lifecycle upgrades, hardening, and vulnerability remediation for on-premises and AWS-hosted Linux VMs.

* Design and maintain Ansible Automation Platform playbooks, roles, inventories, templates, and workflows for provisioning, configuration, patching, validation, compliance, and reporting.

* Support production Linux VMs and business-critical applications, including Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS), in partnership with application and database teams.

* Lead complex incident troubleshooting and root-cause analysis across OpenShift, Linux, applications, and dependent infrastructure services.

* Remain hands-on while leading design reviews, operational-readiness reviews, troubleshooting sessions, and major incident resolution.

* Mentor engineers and communicate technical risks, dependencies, options, and recommendations clearly to stakeholders.

* Coordinate with application, database, cloud, security, network, storage, backup, identity, datacenter, and vendor teams.

  

What you'll Bring

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Minimum of 8 years of experience in IT infrastructure, with at least 4 years in a senior technical role focused on Linux and/or virtualization.
* Proven expertise with Red Hat OpenShift, including OpenShift Virtualization (KubeVirt).
* Strong proficiency in Linux operating systems (e.g., RHEL, CentOS, Ubuntu) and system administration.
* Extensive experience with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) and orchestration.
* Solid understanding of networking concepts (TCP/IP, DNS, Load Balancing) and storage solutions in a cloud-native environment.
* Experience with automation tools and scripting (e.g., Ansible, Python, Bash).
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps methodologies.
* Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
* Relevant certifications (e.g., Red Hat Certified Engineer, Kubernetes Administrator) are a plus.

title: Staff Database Engineer
description:

Our full-service HR solutions include features such as payroll processing, human capital consulting, employment law compliance and employee benefits, including health insurance, retirement plans and workers’ compensation insurance.  
  
TriNet has a nationwide presence and an experienced executive team. Our stock is publicly traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol TNET. If you’re passionate about innovation and making an impact on the large SMB market, come join us as we power our clients’ business success with extraordinary HR.

title: Specialist, Product Operations, Reference Data
description:
Job Description:

**Job Purpose**

The primary purpose of this position is to research, analyze, interpret, transform and present reference data for Equity and Funds securities across global markets, while supporting the Index team by providing reference data with precision. The focus of this position is to perform this work with documents written in English.

The incumbent must successfully complete a 8-to-12-week training program that centers on building enough subject matter expertise and the utilization of the database(s) of record such that the incumbent can independently analyze legal and financial documents associated with Equity and Fund securities. During training, the incumbent must master all of the subject matter and will be required to pass a series of quizzes and tests as well achieve the accuracy and timeliness metrics that were established for trainees.

The training curriculum for Data Analyst contains high level overviews of the complex structures worked on by more senior personnel as well as reference data client use cases so that the incumbent can differentiate between legal and financial language that is relevant to and required by our client base versus jargon describing information that is not required and, so that the incumbent can identify new financing techniques that come to market. The incumbent must then apply this foundation of knowledge via a logical sequence of decision-making events to determine relevancy of said information to our clients for any of their use cases and if deemed relevant, determine the appropriate next steps to ensure high client satisfaction levels.

The Equity and Funds asset class consists significantly large volumes of active securities and the reference data provided by ICE Data Services for said securities is used by our clients to make trading decisions, settle trades, make investment decisions, manage portfolios, analyze risk, create security master files, create client statements and conduct other back-office functions. Our reference data is also used by internal stakeholders such as the Evaluated Pricing, Index and Analytics groups said reference data plays an integral role in determining evaluated prices, determining whether or not a security should be added to or deleted from an index or indices, the weighted average of a security within an index and, performing a series of analytical calculations that are used both internally within ICE and externally by these stakeholder’s clientele.

**Responsibilities**

* Analyze, interpret, collate, and transform reference data for multi structure/events/sub processes with high complexity in either the primary market or the secondary market (but not both) provided in a variety of legal and financial documents, third party reports and vendor information, while ensuring that the reference data provided in ICE’s products and services accurate, comprehensive and in a timely manner, namely best in class.
* Demonstrate familiarity with reference data products to support client challenges and resolve data problems.
* Build core competencies in the maintenance of reference data captured in alternate databases used to produce products.
* Independently perform all assigned business processes completely and accurately.
* Conduct user acceptance testing of new enhancements and bug fixes made to the database(s) of record
* Craft external facing responses for those clients that submitted customer inquiries containing a meaningful, well-thought out, well-constructed answer that includes a restatement of the challenge or question, the analysis completed to satisfy the request and where appropriate, the methodology used to determine the solution when researching and resolving client inquiries.
* Identifies trends and causation of inaccurate and/or incomplete data including but not limited to staying current with regulatory initiatives, new financing techniques used by the marketplace and organizations that impact coverage and completeness.
* Create simple excel and macro functions to organize, analyze, convert, and create reference data.
* Demonstrate extensive knowledge and understanding of policies and procedures and work with training team to augment best practices as changes in the marketplace evolve.
* Applies problem-solving skills to identify and help to resolve data quality issues and/or work-flow inefficiencies and process improvements resulting in increased accuracy levels, time to market and productivity.
* Participate in root cause analysis efforts to identify system data issues and participate in creating process improvements. Resolve complex data challenges and time critical sensitive projects.
* Create charts, graphs, and presentations for leadership teams.
* Communicate with and influence market participants including underwriters, issuers, trust administrators and exchanges through phone and email correspondence to procure required reference data content, resolve data discrepancies and gain an understanding of undefined terms.
* Make sound, subjective decisions when interpreting legal and financial information by utilizing subject matter expertise to infer, deduce and ultimately draw the correct conclusions. Mentor junior employees provide guidance; serve as subject matter experts.

**Knowledge and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience required
* 5+ years corporate level experience, or 2+ years direct experience.
* Ability to work in a fast paced, high pressured, fluid environment
* Ability to distill large amounts of varied information into specific takeaways
* Excellent attention to detail and high degree of demonstrated decision-making and problem-solving skills
* Strong analytical skills
* Eagerness to learn and collaborate with others
* Strong excel skills required

If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of **Process Optimisation and Modeling Senior Associate.**

**In this role, you will:**

* Test and develop new databases through the product lifecycle.
* Facilitate the Admin tasks of existing processes.
* Facilitate the production of standard operating process, related to the headcount planning and forecasting process.
* Act as point of contact for any database related queries as part of the Digital Command Centre program roll out.
* Be the key expert to advise on impacts of projects on database structures.
* Understanding and translating Global Operations (and Group) strategy into immediate business/function and aligning direction for self and teams
* Setting world class standards and embedding these in immediate business/function area
* Leading from the front by courageously setting and executing stretching goals for the immediate business/function area

**To be successful you will:**

* Proven Anaplan model building skills and building integrations between databases and external applications.
* Have experience looking after large project deliverables using an Agile methodology.
* Demonstrate a strong desire to learn and adapt to changing environments.
* Strong willed and able to lead and take initiative when direction is vague.

title: Senior Consultant, ServiceNow, ITSM
description:
**Practice:** Application Modernization
  
  
**Position Title:** Senior Consultant, ServiceNow, ITSM
  
  
**Position Location:** On-Site
  
  
**Reports to:** Vice President, Observability
  
  
The person needs to work in US overlapping timings (5 PM to 2 AM).
  
  
**Job Summary:**  
A Senior Consultant, ServiceNow specializes in IT Service Management (ITSM), Customer Service Management (CSM), and Configuration Management Database (CMDB). This role involves leading implementations, optimizing processes, and ensuring platform stability while aligning with ITIL best practices. The consultant will work closely with stakeholders to deliver high-quality ServiceNow solutions that enhance operational efficiency and customer experience.
  
  
**Essential Functions:**  

* Design, configure, and implement ServiceNow ITSM and CSM modules.
* Build and maintain CMDB structure, relationships, and integrations.
* Develop workflows, business rules, and automation scripts.
* Implement Incident, Problem, Change, Request, and Knowledge Management processes.
* Align ITSM workflows with ITIL best practices.
* Configure case management, portals, and customer workflows.
* Integrate CSM with external systems for seamless customer experience.
* Implement Discovery and Service Mapping for accurate CI population.
* Perform platform upgrades, patches, and ensure compliance with ServiceNow standards.
* Monitor system performance and troubleshoot issues proactively.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Required Skills/Abilities/Competencies:**  

* 5+ years of hands-on experience with ServiceNow implementation and administration.
* Strong expertise in ITSM, CSM, and CMDB modules.
* Proficiency in scripting (JavaScript, Glide) and integrations (REST, SOAP, APIs).
* Knowledge of ITIL framework and best practices.
* Excellent communication and client-facing skills.

**Education and Experience:**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA).
* ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (ITSM, CSM).
* ITIL Foundation Certification

title: Database Administrator (Microsoft SQL Server)
description:
Overview:

We are seeking a highly skilled Microsoft SQL Server Database Administrator (SQL DBA) to manage, maintain, optimize, and secure mission-critical SQL Server database environments across on-premises and cloud platforms. The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring high availability, performance, scalability, security, and reliability of enterprise database systems while supporting business-critical applications.

  
Responsibilities:

Database Administration

* Thorough knowledge in Install, configure, upgrade, patch, and maintain Microsoft SQL Server environments.
* Experience in configuring and maintaining SQL Server Always On Availability Groups, Failover Cluster Instances (FCI), Log Shipping, Replication, and Database Mirroring.
* Hands-on on database refreshes, migrations, and upgrades with minimal downtime.

Backup, Recovery & Disaster Recovery

* Design and implement backup and recovery strategies using native SQL Server tools and enterprise backup solutions.
* Support business continuity planning and database resilience initiatives.

Performance Tuning & Optimization

* Analyze and optimize database performance through indexing, query tuning, execution plan analysis, and resource management.
* Perform capacity planning and recommend infrastructure improvements.

Cloud & Automation

* Manage SQL Server databases hosted on:
  + Azure SQL Database
  + Azure SQL Managed Instance
  + SQL Server on Azure Virtual Machines
  + AWS RDS for SQL Server
* Automate DBA tasks using PowerShell, T-SQL, Azure Automation, and scripting tools.
* Support Infrastructure-as-Code and DevOps initiatives where applicable.
* Participate in database deployment automation and CI/CD integration.

Security & Compliance

* Implement database security best practices, including role-based access control (RBAC).
* Manage encryption technologies such as Transparent Data Encryption (TDE), Always Encrypted, and TLS/SSL.
* Perform vulnerability assessments and apply security patches.
* Support compliance requirements, auditing, and data governance initiatives.

Monitoring & Operational Support

* Collaborate with application, infrastructure, cloud, and security teams to resolve incidents.
* Develop and maintain operational documentation and standard operating procedures.

  
Qualifications:  

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science or equivalent work experience
* Over 10 years of Database Administration
* Cloud Computing / Distributed Systems
* Certifications in Microsoft SQL Server Database Administration
* AWS/Azure/GCP certifications

Required Skills

* 10+ years of experience administering Microsoft SQL Server databases.
* Strong expertise with SQL Server 2016/2019/2022.
* Experience with:
  + Always On Availability Groups
  + Failover Clustering
  + Replication
  + Log Shipping
  + Database Mirroring
* Strong knowledge of:
  + T-SQL
  + Query tuning
  + Execution plan analysis
  + Index optimization
  + Performance troubleshooting
* Hands-on experience with backup and recovery strategies.
* Experience managing SQL Server in Azure and/or AWS cloud environments.
* Knowledge of Windows Server administration and PowerShell scripting.
* Experience with database migrations, upgrades, and consolidation projects.
* Familiarity with monitoring tools such as:
  + SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS)
  + SQL Server Profiler
  + SolarWinds DPA
  + Azure Monitor

title: Senior Oracle Database Administrator
description:
**About the role**

As a Senior Oracle Database Administrator, you are a results‑driven, customer‑focused technical leader responsible for the reliability, performance, and security of Blackbaud’s enterprise Oracle database platforms. You bring a strong sense of ownership and accountability, delivering outcomes that support both operational excellence and customer commitments while helping power the work of purpose‑driven organisations.

**What you’ll do**

* Deliver reliable and secure Oracle database services by owning day‑to‑day operations, availability, and performance across production environments.
* Improve scalability and resilience by installing, upgrading, patching, and managing Oracle databases using automation‑first approaches.
* Protect critical data by executing and validating backup, recovery, replication, and high‑availability strategies.
* Partner with application and cloud teams to optimise performance, support migrations, and ensure operational readiness for new and existing solutions.
* Monitor database health and capacity using industry‑standard tools, proactively identifying risks and resolving issues before they impact customers.
* Strengthen operational excellence by maintaining clear documentation, standards, and runbooks, and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives.

**What you’ll bring**

* 5–8 years of professional experience administering Oracle databases in enterprise, production environments.
* Hands‑on experience administering Oracle databases in Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, including Oracle Database on OCI and Oracle Exadata Cloud Service.
* Strong knowledge of Oracle database operations, including performance tuning, backup and recovery, and high‑availability architectures.
* Familiarity with OCI core services as they relate to databases, including compute, storage, networking, and identity and access management.
* Hands‑on experience with Linux systems and database automation or scripting to reduce manual effort and improve reliability. Available on a 24x7x365 basis when needed for production impacting incidents or key customer events

  
**Leverage AI-assisted tools to accelerate delivery and improve quality and actively experiment with emerging capabilities as they evolve**

Stay up to date on everything Blackbaud, follow us on Linkedin, X, Instagram, Facebook and YouTube

Blackbaud powers social impact through purpose‑driven technology and responsible AI. Guided by our *Intelligence for Good®* vision, we’re building a culture where innovation, trust, and human expertise come together to help organizations make a greater difference in the world.

Blackbaud is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to maintaining an inclusive work environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, physical or mental disability, age, or veteran status or any other basis protected by federal, state, or local law.

**About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.


Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.


We’re Salesforce, the Customer Company, inspiring the future of business with AI\+ Data \+CRM.
